newsitem.title: USA: Key Plastics extends offer for senior notes.
newsitem.headline: Key Plastics extends offer for senior notes.

text.p: Key Plastics Inc said Wednesday its offer to purchase all its outstanding 14 percent senior notes due 1999 was extended until 1400 EST today.
The offer was originally set to expire at midnight Tuesday.
Financial and other terms are unchanged.

To date, senior notes totaling $39,860,000 principal amount, or 61.3 percent of the outstanding senior notes, have been deposited in the tender offer and have provided consents in the consent solicitation.
Lehman Brothers is the dealer manager for the offer.
